# Tests.
#
#   test_layout, test_widgets, test_xml, test_threads, test_memory, test_animation,
#   test_text_editor, test_shell, test_dialogs, test_themes, test_markdown, test_tools,
#   test_locale, test_xmlc, test_xmlcpp (an .xmlc and an .xmlc++ compiled by ravenc)
#       run headless (null platform + null backend): no display and no GPU are
#       needed, so they run on any build machine.
#   test_render
#       renders real frames with the Vulkan backend and checks pixels. It is
#       reported as skipped when the machine has no usable Vulkan driver.
#
#   raven_benchmark
#       not a test: prints layout and paint timings for a large widget tree.
#
#   ctest --output-on-failure

function(raven_add_test name)
	add_executable(${name} ${name}.c test.h)
	target_link_libraries(${name} PRIVATE raven::raven)
	set_target_properties(${name} PROPERTIES C_STANDARD 11 C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON FOLDER "tests")
	if(NOT WIN32)
		target_link_libraries(${name} PRIVATE m)
	endif()
	if(MSVC)
		target_compile_definitions(${name} PRIVATE _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)
	endif()
	if(NOT RAVEN_WITH_STB_IMAGE)
		target_compile_definitions(${name} PRIVATE RAVEN_TEST_NO_IMAGE_DECODER)
	endif()
	add_test(NAME ${name} COMMAND ${name})
endfunction()

# The test programs are translated to Zig (tests/<name>.zig + the harness tests/test.zig, from
# test.h). Each is compiled by zig into one object that exports main, and linked with the library
# through the C ABI exactly like the C program was. RAVEN_TESTS_ZIG=OFF builds the C originals
# (kept in tests/*.c), e.g. for check.sh --make-baseline.
option(RAVEN_TESTS_ZIG "Build the Zig translations of the test programs (OFF: the C originals)" ON)
if(RAVEN_TESTS_ZIG)
	if(RAVEN_ZIG_EXECUTABLE)
		set(RAVEN_TESTS_ZIG_EXE "${RAVEN_ZIG_EXECUTABLE}")
	else()
		find_program(RAVEN_TESTS_ZIG_EXE zig)
	endif()
	if(NOT RAVEN_TESTS_ZIG_EXE)
		message(FATAL_ERROR "Raven tests: the test programs are written in Zig, so the zig compiler is needed (put zig in PATH, or set RAVEN_ZIG_EXECUTABLE, or -DRAVEN_TESTS_ZIG=OFF for the C tests)")
	endif()
	# the build options the tests look at (the C tests see them as preprocessor macros)
	set(_raven_test_cfg "// Generated by tests/CMakeLists.txt: the options of this build the tests depend on.\n")
	if(RAVEN_WITH_STB_IMAGE)
		string(APPEND _raven_test_cfg "pub const no_image_decoder = false;\n")
	else()
		string(APPEND _raven_test_cfg "pub const no_image_decoder = true;\n")
	endif()
	file(WRITE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/zig/test_config.zig.tmp" "${_raven_test_cfg}")
	configure_file("${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/zig/test_config.zig.tmp" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/zig/test_config.zig" COPYONLY)
endif()

# raven_add_zig_program(<target> <root .zig> <extra dependencies>...): a program written in Zig,
# linked with Raven by the C linker
function(raven_add_zig_program name root)
	set(_obj "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/zig/${name}${CMAKE_C_OUTPUT_EXTENSION}")
	set(_args build-obj -O${RAVEN_ZIG_OPTIMIZE} -lc -fno-stack-check)
	if(NOT WIN32)
		list(APPEND _args -fPIC)
	endif()
	if(RAVEN_ZIG_TARGET)
		list(APPEND _args -target ${RAVEN_ZIG_TARGET})
	endif()
	list(APPEND _args --name ${name} --cache-dir "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/zig/cache"
		--dep raven --dep test_config -Mroot=${root}
		-Mraven=${RAVEN_ZIG_DIR}/src/raven/raven.zig
		-Mtest_config=${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/zig/test_config.zig
		-femit-bin=${_obj})
	add_custom_command(
		OUTPUT "${_obj}"
		COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E make_directory "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/zig"
		COMMAND "${RAVEN_TESTS_ZIG_EXE}" ${_args}
		DEPENDS "${root}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/test.zig" "${RAVEN_ZIG_DIR}/src/raven/raven.zig"
			"${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/zig/test_config.zig" ${ARGN}
		COMMENT "Zig: ${name}"
		VERBATIM)
	set_source_files_properties("${_obj}" PROPERTIES EXTERNAL_OBJECT TRUE GENERATED TRUE)
	add_executable(${name} "${_obj}")
	target_link_libraries(${name} PRIVATE raven::raven)
	set_target_properties(${name} PROPERTIES LINKER_LANGUAGE C FOLDER "tests")
	if(NOT WIN32)
		target_link_libraries(${name} PRIVATE m)
	endif()
endfunction()

# raven_add_test_zig_or_c(<name>): tests/<name>.zig when RAVEN_TESTS_ZIG, else tests/<name>.c
function(raven_add_test_zig_or_c name)
	if(RAVEN_TESTS_ZIG AND EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${name}.zig")
		raven_add_zig_program(${name} "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${name}.zig")
		add_test(NAME ${name} COMMAND ${name})
	else()
		raven_add_test(${name})
	endif()
endfunction()

raven_add_test_zig_or_c(test_layout)
raven_add_test_zig_or_c(test_widgets)
raven_add_test_zig_or_c(test_xml)
raven_add_test_zig_or_c(test_threads)
raven_add_test_zig_or_c(test_memory)
raven_add_test_zig_or_c(test_animation)
raven_add_test_zig_or_c(test_text_editor)
raven_add_test_zig_or_c(test_shell)
raven_add_test_zig_or_c(test_dock_tearing)
raven_add_test_zig_or_c(test_editor_features)
raven_add_test_zig_or_c(test_dialogs)
raven_add_test_zig_or_c(test_themes)
raven_add_test_zig_or_c(test_markdown)
raven_add_test_zig_or_c(test_tools)
raven_add_test_zig_or_c(test_locale)

# an interface in XMLC (XML + C), compiled by ravenc
add_executable(test_xmlc test_xmlc.xmlc test.h)
target_link_libraries(test_xmlc PRIVATE raven::raven)
target_include_directories(test_xmlc PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
set_target_properties(test_xmlc PROPERTIES C_STANDARD 11 FOLDER "tests")
if(NOT WIN32)
	target_link_libraries(test_xmlc PRIVATE m)
endif()
if(MSVC)
	target_compile_definitions(test_xmlc PRIVATE _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)
endif()
raven_target_xmlc(test_xmlc)
add_test(NAME test_xmlc COMMAND test_xmlc)

# the same in C++ (.xmlc++)
enable_language(CXX)
add_executable(test_xmlcpp test_xmlcpp.xmlc++ test.h)
target_link_libraries(test_xmlcpp PRIVATE raven::raven)
target_include_directories(test_xmlcpp PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
set_target_properties(test_xmlcpp PROPERTIES CXX_STANDARD 17 FOLDER "tests")
if(MSVC)
	target_compile_definitions(test_xmlcpp PRIVATE _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)
endif()
raven_target_xmlc(test_xmlcpp)
add_test(NAME test_xmlcpp COMMAND test_xmlcpp)

if(RAVEN_BACKEND_VULKAN)
	raven_add_test_zig_or_c(test_render)
	set_tests_properties(test_render PROPERTIES SKIP_RETURN_CODE 77)
endif()

# Not a test: prints timings for a large widget tree (see the top of benchmark.c / benchmark.zig).
if(RAVEN_TESTS_ZIG AND EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/benchmark.zig")
	raven_add_zig_program(raven_benchmark "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/benchmark.zig")
else()
	add_executable(raven_benchmark benchmark.c)
	target_link_libraries(raven_benchmark PRIVATE raven::raven)
	set_target_properties(raven_benchmark PROPERTIES C_STANDARD 11 C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON FOLDER "tests")
	if(MSVC)
		target_compile_definitions(raven_benchmark PRIVATE _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)
	endif()
endif()
